{{Quote|I could mix a little Pig-lizard Flu with a strain of Gamorrean Mumps&hellip; oh, yeah&mdash;this is going somewhere.|Doc|<ref name="Opportunity Knocks">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Opportunity Knocks}}</ref>}}
'''Pig-lizard Flu''' was a type of [[Flu/Legends|flu]] that was known to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While contemplating the idea of creating his own virus in order to cure it and therefore become famous,<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" /> the [[xenopathologist]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]]&mdash;better known as Doc&mdash;considered combining Pig-lizard Flu with [[Gamorrean Mumps]] as a starting point.<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" /> The flu was named after "pig-lizard," a derogatory term for a member of the porcine [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Aggravated Assault">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Aggravated Assault|Belsavis}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pig-lizard Flu was first mentioned in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the conversation "Opportunity Knocks" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class' companion character Doc.<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />
